lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like matrix posterior to the gill slits. Primary centroids form a series of longitudinal chains, with the most prominent spots located in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal chains of high-luminance blobs, forming distinct anchor nodes particularly visible in the central third of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient transition along the longitudinal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, dark, circular indentation or lesion is visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, superior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high density of small-diameter high-luminance blobs, which are significantly smaller and more concentrated than the larger clusters on the lateral flank.
